title: one int4 weight payload to multiple Mirror decodes
hypothesis: One serialized int4 matrix plus charged Givens coordinates can reconstruct four aligned logical weight matrices with activation-output error comparable to individually quantized matrices while using substantially fewer actual serialized bytes.
mirror_coordinate: Four float32 Givens angles, included in the payload
controls: shared int4 plus per-role rank-2 residual
per-role int4 plus rank-2 QER residual

development.selection_metric: held-out Gaussian activation-output MSE and relative Frobenius error; no trainable hyperparameters

storage.authority: exact custom serialized inference payload bytes

success_gate: On aligned fresh worlds, Mirror activation-output MSE <=1.10x independent int4 and <=0.10x hard-tied int4; payload <=0.60x independent int4. Report shared-QER residual controls and independent teacher as boundaries.
failure_gate: Both development worlds miss either the 1.10x independent-int4 quality ratio or the 0.60x byte ratio. Keep fresh worlds sealed after failure.
boundaries: Teacher generated by the same Givens orbit as Mirror
One fixed int4 quantizer; no training updates
